At can_rmdir() we start by searching the orphan dirs rbtree for an orphan
dir object for the target directory. Later when iterating over the dir
index keys
column2: if we find that any dir entry points to inode for which there

column1: is a pending dir move or the inode was not yet processed
we can't remove the directory yet. However we end up always calling
add_orphan_dir_info()
column2: which will iterate again the rbtree and if there is

column1: already an orphan dir object (created by the first call to can_rmdir())
it returns the existing object. This is unnecessary work because in case
there is already an existing orphan dir object
column2: we got a reference to it

column1: at the start of can_rmdir(). So skip the call to add_orphan_dir_info()
if we already have a reference for an orphan dir object.
This patch is part of a larger patchset and the changelog of the last
patch in the series contains a sample performance test and results.
The patches that comprise the patchset are the following:
